_status: Official fonts (Cairo, Playfair Display) and logo files from the owner's Drive (2026-10-09). Colors sampled from the posts and logo; confirm against guidelines when available.

voice.ar: Calm, confident, clear. Short sentences. Formal-friendly Modern Standard Arabic (as in the posts: «نرافقكم في كل خطوة»). No hype words, no exaggeration of property facts.

latinLabel.note: spaced caps labels like REAL ESTATE

motifs.bracket: Thin copper vertical bracket with end caps and a midpoint dot, on the outer side of right-aligned text.
motifs.lineArt: Gold hairline arches and a column behind content.
motifs.paper: Warm parchment background with fibre texture; architecture fades into it.
motifs.counter: Pagination '01 / 03' bottom-left with a short rule above.

motion.tempo: Measured. Titles settle in 0.8-1.4s on the 'architectural' ease. Lines draw, they do not pop.

logoRules: Use the files exactly. The O is a circle holding the domed arch with columns, with the copper roof chevron above. Never redraw, recolor, stretch or rebuild it from type. Arabic films use logoAr; English or mixed use logo.
